reviewedScope.limits: This is a source-linked authored coherence review. It is not exhaustive runtime state-space testing, human playtesting or numerical balance certification.

dispositions.evidence: AC6-N15 now follows the frozen Ready rule: Action and 10 RP are committed at t20.5 and only the perceivable trigger is declared then; at t24.5 Reaction release the fixed area point (0,0,11) is selected and rechecked, before the t26 Ready deadline. No second cast or RP payment occurs.

The first qualifying Null Skybrand hit takes the significant NPC from 8 to Stable0, which under current zero-HP rules also makes it Unconscious and Prone. Skybrand's NEW source-specific spatial bridge uses the blade point only for its own attack reach/LoE/distance predicates while the Wizard remains dealer/root owner. The second attack is within 5 ft, has advantage [7,11], hits on 19, and is automatically critical; doubled 2d12 [2,3]=5 ordinary damage at already 0 HP cancels Stable recovery and adds two death-save failures. No global remote-sense or attacker-body rule is created.

AC6-N01 restores the actual perceived-enemy predicate and the explicit failed DEX save 8 vs DC16 before full shared 5d8=22 damage to the outside recipient. AC6-N02 preserves Wizard /cards/19 as a rank3 spell: the outside branch legally commits 3 RP and Recharge2, then Globe suppresses the incoming rank3 application before any higher-rank task; the independent inside branch pays the same real cost and succeeds at 16 vs DC16.

Accepted Greater Dispel automatically ends ordinary spell applications of recorded rank0-5. AC6-N10 therefore ends Lesser Antimagic F1 at t20 without a check; the immutable snapshot still leaves simultaneously captured Seal/parent termination operations suppressed and they do not replay after F1 ends. AC6-RX03 correctly separates the different branch where Wizard class Dispel remains inside a still-active suppressor and spends its real 3 RP/Recharge2 without executing its task.

PB-D03 now uses the complete wall volume x[-15,15], y[-0.5,0.5], z[0,15] and sphere x^2+y^2+(z-5)^2<=100. The four central 5x5x1 panel volumes have farthest squared distance 25+0.25+25=50.25<100 and are therefore fully suppressed. The Large body's positive-volume interior overlap is exactly those four panels; mere contact with neighboring faces/edges is not occupancy.

The frozen Planar Barrier identity promises selective blocking but does not itself supply a horizontal platform. The explicit current completion is coherent and narrow: unsupported downward Falling through a top/bottom edge is not stopped or given a new Fall Marker; any qualifying body volume actually overlapping a panel while falling makes that panel pending until clear, while other operative vertical faces continue to stop lateral crossing. This is Planar-Barrier-specific authored geometry and does not create a general movement, support or cosmology rule.

The named current cases again carry the material source-compatible original obligations under the same IDs rather than generic substitutes: Greater Ally Load rejection, exact Healing Rite recovery, NullDisabled expiry, replacement/cargo and used command history; Nexus locked alignment, destination-plane inhabitants versus origin, atomic hidden-Anchor group failure, t599/t600 closure, 20+30 projectile range/no remote caster, remote-mouth dispel plus independent Nexus, and Large receiving depth; PB-D05 mandatory Banishment return; AC6-N20 no-command round, 20+10 route, first miss and actual Net Bolt interruption. These restorations do not change the frozen source/access records.

AC6-RX01 now states all three suppressed summon bodies are already supported on the ground, so the fixture does not imply suppressed Air Pet Hover persistence. AC6-N04 now identifies the AC5 comparison as accepted rather than conditional without changing the underlying rules.

finalCoherenceFinding.statement: Within the reviewed 14-identity / 16-placement AC6 authored scope, no remaining concrete source-conflict or authored-procedure blocker was found in the exact eight current files.
